r.지역: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan
r.문화권·종교: Dari and Pashto · mostly Sunni Muslim
r.경제 체제: Farm economy cut off from aid under Taliban rule · minerals undeveloped
r.한국이 파는 것: Beverages 32%, Cars 23%, Refined petroleum 6%, Vaccines, blood products 6% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Salt, stone, minerals 79%, Ores 16%, Sneakers and footwear 1% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: The Taliban returned to power in 2021. Women are barred from secondary and higher education and from many jobs.

t.why: It is rich in resources such as copper and lithium, but long wars have kept them undeveloped. In 2025 Russia became the first country to recognize the Taliban government.
t.rel: After the Taliban returned to power in 2021, almost no country formally recognized the government until Russia did so first in 2025. It clashes often with Pakistan over militants on the border and has water and refugee issues with Iran.
t.korea: Korea's foreign ministry has placed it under a level-4 travel ban. Korea withdrew its embassy and in 2021 brought Afghans who had worked with it to Korea.
t.know: Two giant Buddhas in the Bamiyan Valley were blown up by the Taliban in 2001; only the empty niches remain.
t.etext: Farming and herding are the basis of livelihoods, and opium poppy cultivation long made up a big share. Copper, lithium and other minerals lie underground but are barely developed. After the Taliban took power in 2021, foreign aid and foreign-exchange reserves were frozen and the economy shrank sharply.
